lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba4Mg2W2O12 (reduced formula Ba2MgWO6) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 74), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg and W each coordinated by six O neighbors in octahedral environments, while Ba exhibits a close-packed-like arrangement with 12 O neighbors. Corner-sharing between Mg and W octahedra is observed, and polyhedra sharing also includes corner, edge, and face contacts between Ba and Mg, as well as Ba and W. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
